I have resolved the proxy authentication issue by updating [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dvt72k2u/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dvt72k2u/requests/utils.py) to include the `auth` component when reconstructing `netloc` from `urllib3.util.parse_url`.

Previously, `parsed.netloc` from `urllib3.util.parse_url` only included `host` and `port`, stripping authentication credentials from proxy URLs before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dvt72k2u/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted them.
